steps.text: Chapter 2.2: Digital Marketing and Community Building. Let's read it together, and I'll explain each part as we go.
Listen before you sell

Eat Better started by interacting directly with customers through exhibitions and direct selling . These interactions helped the brand understand customer preferences, receive feedback , and improve its products.
Exhibitions and direct selling
Example If customers at an exhibition ask for smaller snack packs at affordable prices, the brand can use this feedback to explore a new product size.
Key concept Listen to customers first; use their feedback to improve the business.
1 Meet customers
2 Hear feedback
3 Improve the product
Here's the idea: Eat Better's marketing started by listening. At exhibitions, the team met customers, heard their feedback, and improved the products.
Channels the brand controls
A brand can communicate with customers through platforms and channels it manages, such as its website, email lists, and blog .
Found my perfect snack! — Eat Better Co on YouTube
Example A customer signs up for emails and later receives an update about a new snack launch.
Key concept Owned channels help brands maintain direct relationships with customers rather than depending entirely on social media or marketplaces .
In simple words: Today the brand also talks to customers through channels it controls, like its website, email and blog.
One brand, four platforms
Social media helps brands reach people, showcase products, and interact with potential customers.
Reel by Eat Better Co on Instagram
Eat Better Co · Original audio
From a home kitchen to building a 50,000 sq ft factory — Eat Better Co on YouTube
Example An Instagram reel showing a snack being enjoyed during a work break may introduce the product to people looking for convenient snack options.
Key concept Each platform serves a different purpose. Brands should select platforms based on their target audience and marketing goals.
Think of it like this: On social media, one brand appears on four platforms: Instagram, YouTube, Facebook and LinkedIn.
Story, purpose, people
Customers are more likely to connect with a brand when they understand its story, purpose, and people.
Facing the Sharks? — Eat Better Co on YouTube
